issue.title: Popup menu not displaying properly with long completion and two split windows
issue.body:
This scenario comes with making a long completion in two panes.

![2017-02-26 21 12 31](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/19645990/23346496/affd9236-fc68-11e6-9a4c-521726b1d17b.gif)

body:
This problem is occurred in Vim?
If so, it should be reported in Vim repository.

I can confirm this is happening in Vim 7.4.1689 and 8.0.344.  It happens when the buffer scrolls horizontally to display the cursor at the end of the completion.

![compl](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/111942/23390848/8a68c8b6-fd3e-11e6-88f8-447b55b6474a.gif)
OK.  This is Vim problem.  It should be reported.
Well, I didn't actually check if it was the same issue.  I just recalled a patch related to pmenu from ages ago.  @tweekmonster said it didn't help.

> I didn't see any effect from the patch.

Yeah, it was a shot in the dark.  Looking back at the Debian bug, it's a different issue with the pmenu. :)

As far as your patch, the gif looks good. :) Not sure if there's a better way to handle that.  Maybe propose the current patch upstream and see what happens?

issue.title: Redraw screen if completion causes horizontal scrolling
issue.body:
Issue brought up on Neovim: https://github.com/neovim/neovim/issues/6184

When the popup menu is displayed over an adjacent window and a completion causes the window to scroll horizontally to center the cursor, the previous popup area is not redrawn.

Wasn't sure if there's a smarter way to do this, but I think a screen clear is sufficient considering that this *shouldn't* happen often under normal circumstances.

Before:

![before](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/111942/23390848/8a68c8b6-fd3e-11e6-88f8-447b55b6474a.gif)

After:

![after](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/111942/23439666/c07db298-fde5-11e6-99b8-9319becf3532.gif)

issue.body:
#### vim-patch:8.0.0390

Problem:    When the window scrolls horizontally when the popup menu is
            displayed part of it may not be cleared. (Neovim issue #6184)
Solution:   Remove the menu when the windows scrolled. (closes vim/vim#1524)

Fixes #6184
